claims.claim_text: Air Products is the primary beneficiary of NEOM Green Hydrogen Company (NGHC), constructing a multi-billion-dollar green hydrogen-based ammonia facility in NEOM City, Saudi Arabia, with APD as the exclusive offtaker under a long-term take-if-tendered agreement, and JV partners ACWA Power and NEOM Company. NGHC has access to ~$6.1B project financing (~73% of project cost), and APD issued performance guarantees up to ~$0.8B as EPC contractor (expiring November 2028). FY2025 capex included ~$3B for NEOM. APD expects the project to come onstream and deliver green ammonia in 2027.

claims.source_quote: The NEOM Green Hydrogen Project is a multi-billion dollar green hydrogen-based ammonia production facility that is being constructed in NEOM City, Saudi Arabia. Owned and operated by NGHC, the facility will be powered by renewable energy to produce green ammonia for Air Products as the exclusive offtaker under a long-term take-if-tendered agreement... NGHC has access to project financing of approximately $6.1 billion, which is expected to fund about 73% of the project... we expect to come onstream and deliver green ammonia in 2027.

claims.claim_text: In FY2025 (year ended 30 September 2025) Air Products recognized approximately $3.7 billion of pre-tax charges for business and asset actions, ~$3.6B of which were project-exit costs primarily related to clean energy generation and distribution projects (cancellation/descoping of several large energy transition projects), with cash outflows projected to be ~$355M once exits are fully implemented. Operating loss for FY2025 was $877M (vs. operating income of $4.5B in FY2024), driven by these charges.

claims.source_quote: we recognized project exit costs totaling approximately $3.6 billion, primarily consisting of noncash asset write-downs and estimated costs to terminate contractual commitments... The remaining charge of $123.7 in fiscal year 2025 related to severance and other employee benefits under a global cost reduction program... Operating loss was $877.0 compared to operating income of $4.5 billion in fiscal year 2024. The operating loss in fiscal year 2025 included approximately $3.7 billion in pre-tax charges related to business and asset actions ($3.0 billion after tax, or $13.68 per share).

claims.claim_text: Air Products exited the World Energy sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) expansion project in Paramount, California in FY2025. APD recorded a $300 million allowance for credit loss on the World Energy financing receivable and wrote off the entire $329.4M of World Energy deferred project costs that were on the FY2024 balance sheet. APD states it has no further loss exposure related to World Energy as of 30 September 2025 but acknowledges future earnings impacts are possible as exit is finalized.

claims.claim_text: Air Products invested ~$7.0B in additions to plant and equipment in FY2025 (including long-term deposits), with capital expenditures (non-GAAP) of $5.1B, primarily supporting clean energy initiatives including NEOM and clean energy complexes in Louisiana, United States, and Alberta, Canada. FY2026 capex guidance is ~$4B with ~$1B for traditional industrial gas projects.

claims.claim_text: Air Products operates the Jazan Integrated Gasification and Power Company (JIGPC) joint venture with Saudi Aramco Power Company (Aramco subsidiary), ACWA Power, and Air Products Qudra (APQ). JIGPC supplies electricity, steam, hydrogen and utilities to Aramco's refinery and terminal complex under a 25-year agreement that has commenced. APD made a $115M final investment in JIGPC in FY2025. Equity-affiliates income from the Middle East & India segment (largely JIGPC) was $340.9M in FY2025.

claims.claim_text: Air Products' Blue Hydrogen Industrial Gases Company (BHIG) was deconsolidated in January 2025 when APQ issued equity in BHIG to Saudi Aramco Development Company, creating a 50/50 JV that derecognized ~$675M of long-term project-financing debt from APD's balance sheet. BHIG is constructing plants and pipelines to distribute hydrogen, nitrogen and oxygen in Jubail Industrial City, Saudi Arabia. APD made ~$238M in advances to BHIG (now equity affiliate) during FY2025.
